title: MemoNoveltyAgent: A Historical Research Memory-Aware Agent Workflow for Paper Novelty Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2603.20884v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: To alleviate the heavy burden of paper screening, researchers increasingly rely on existing AI agents, such as AI reviewers or DeepResearch, for paper evaluation and novelty assessment. However, lacking specialized mechanisms for processing scholarly literature, their analyses often produce superficial results with noticeable deficiencies in quality. To bridge this gap, we introduce MemoNoveltyAgent, a multi-agent system designed to generate comprehensive and faithful novelty reports. Beyond retrieving concrete prior-paper evidence via RAG, our system incorporates a high-level abstract memory constructed from large-scale scholarly corpora. This memory organizes research into hierarchical trees to distill field-specific evolutionary trajectories, thereby providing a broader historical context. translated_title: MemoNoveltyAgent：一种具有历史研究记忆感知的论文新颖性评估智能体工作流
translated_abstract: 为减轻论文筛选的沉重负担，研究人员越来越依赖现有的AI智能体（如AI审稿人或DeepResearch）来进行论文评估与新颖性评估。然而，由于缺乏处理学术文献的专门机制，这些分析往往产生肤浅的结果，质量存在明显缺陷。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了MemoNoveltyAgent，这是一个旨在生成全面且忠实的新颖性报告的多智能体系统。除了通过RAG检索具体的先前论文证据外，我们的系统还融入了从大规模学术语料库构建的高级抽象记忆。该记忆将研究组织成分层树结构，以提炼出特定领域的演化轨迹，从而提供更广泛的历史背景。此外，我们将论文分解为离散的新颖性点以进行细粒度分析和检索，同时采用自我验证机制……
tldr: 该论文提出MemoNoveltyAgent多智能体系统，通过构建基于大规模学术语料库的分层历史研究记忆、将论文分解为新颖性点进行细粒度分析，并采用自我验证机制，从而生成更全面且忠实的论文新颖性评估报告。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MemoNoveltyAgent, a multi-agent system that generates comprehensive and faithful paper novelty reports by incorporating a hierarchical historical research memory built from large-scale scholarly corpora, decomposing papers into fine-grained novelty points, and employing a self-validation mechanism.
